requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX
flags must be a combination of supported EVP_MD_CTX_FLAG_* values

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_test_flags
functions.description: Tests whether specific flags are set on a digest context. Returns non-zero if any requested flags are set.
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX

functions.name: EVP_DigestInit_ex2
functions.signature: int EVP_DigestInit_ex2(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const EVP_MD *type, const OSSL_PARAM params[]);
functions.description: Initialises a digest context for the specified digest type and optional provider parameters.
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX
type may be NULL if the ctx already has a digest set; otherwise must be a valid EVP_MD
params may be NULL or a valid OSSL_PARAM array appropriate for the digest

functions.name: EVP_DigestInit_ex
functions.signature: int EVP_DigestInit_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *impl /* must be NULL */);
functions.description: Initialises a digest context for the specified digest using the default provider. The ENGINE parameter must be NULL in OpenSSL 3.x.
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX
type must be a valid EVP_MD
impl must be NULL

functions.name: EVP_DigestUpdate
functions.signature: int EVP_DigestUpdate(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const void *d, size_t cnt);
functions.description: Feeds data into the digest computation. Can be called multiple times.
requirements: ctx must be initialised for digesting
d must point to at least cnt bytes; cnt may be zero

functions.name: EVP_DigestFinal_ex
functions.signature: int EVP_DigestFinal_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *s);
functions.description: Finalises the digest and writes the result to md, optionally returning length in s. Context remains reusable for reinit.
requirements: ctx must be initialised and have received all data
md must point to a buffer of at least EVP_MD_CTX_get_size(ctx) bytes
s may be NULL or a valid pointer

functions.name: EVP_Digest
functions.signature: int EVP_Digest(const void *data, size_t count, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *size, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *impl);
functions.description: Convenience one-shot digest function: computes digest of a data buffer for the specified digest type. ENGINE must be NULL in OpenSSL 3.x.
requirements: data must point to at least count bytes (count may be 0)
md must point to a buffer large enough for the digest (up to EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE)
size may be NULL or a valid pointer
type must be a valid EVP_MD
impl must be NULL

functions.name: EVP_Q_digest
functions.signature: int EVP_Q_digest(OSSL_LIB_CTX *libctx, const char *name, const char *propq, const void *data, size_t datalen, unsigned char *md, size_t *mdlen);
functions.description: Provider-query one-shot digest: fetches a digest by name/properties from the given library context and computes the digest of the input buffer.
requirements: libctx may be NULL for default context
name must name a fetchable digest
propq may be NULL or a property query string
data/datalen specify the input buffer
md must point to an output buffer large enough for the digest
mdlen must be a valid pointer to receive the output length

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_copy
functions.description: Copies the state of one digest context to another (legacy alias of copy operation).
requirements: out and in must be valid EVP_MD_CTX pointers
out must be allocated before call

functions.name: EVP_DigestInit
functions.description: Initialises a digest context for the specified digest (legacy simple init).
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX
type must be a valid EVP_MD

functions.name: EVP_DigestFinal
functions.signature: int EVP_DigestFinal(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *s);
functions.description: Finalises the digest and writes the result to md (legacy simple final).
requirements: ctx must be initialised and have received all data
md must point to a buffer large enough for the digest
s may be NULL or a valid pointer

functions.name: EVP_DigestFinalXOF
functions.signature: int EVP_DigestFinalXOF(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *out, size_t outlen);
functions.description: Finalises an extensible-output function (XOF) digest and writes outlen bytes to out.
requirements: ctx must be initialised with an XOF-capable digest (e.g., SHAKE)
out must point to a buffer of at least outlen bytes
outlen must be a non-negative size acceptable to the digest

functions.name: EVP_DigestSqueeze
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DigestSqueeze(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *out, size_t outlen);
functions.description: Squeeze more output bytes from an extensible-output-function (XOF) digest context (e.g., SHAKE) after finalization. Use after initializing/updating the digest with a XOF-capable EVP_MD. Returns 1 for success, 0 for failure.
requirements: ctx must refer to a XOF-capable digest (EVP_MD_xof(ctx->md) true) such as SHAKE; unknown if non-XOF digests are supported (likely error).
out must point to a buffer of at least outlen bytes.
Function returns 1 on success and 0 on failure; callers must check return value.
The digest must be properly initialized (e.g., EVP_DigestInit*_ex2) and in a state that allows squeezing; details of state transitions are not documented here (unknown).

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_serialize
functions.description: Serialize an EVP_MD_CTX into a byte buffer for later restoration via EVP_MD_CTX_deserialize. Useful for saving digest computation state. Returns 1 for success, 0 for failure.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, initialized digest context.
If out is NULL, outlen is set to the required buffer size (typical OpenSSL pattern; exact behavior not explicitly documented here, unknown).
If out is non-NULL, *outlen must indicate available buffer size; on success *outlen is set to bytes written.
Caller must check return value for success.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_deserialize
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_MD_CTX_deserialize(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const unsigned char *in, size_t inlen);
functions.description: Restore an EVP_MD_CTX from a serialized byte sequence produced by EVP_MD_CTX_serialize. Returns 1 for success, 0 for failure.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, allocated EVP_MD_CTX (e.g., via EVP_MD_CTX_new or reset).
in must point to a buffer containing data previously produced by EVP_MD_CTX_serialize; arbitrary data is invalid.
inlen must be the exact length of the serialized data.
Caller must check return value for success.

functions.name: EVP_MD_fetch
functions.description: Fetch a message-digest implementation by name from available providers with an optional property query. Increments refcount on the returned EVP_MD; free with EVP_MD_free.
requirements: algorithm must be a non-NULL name of a digest (e.g., "SHA256", "SHAKE256").
properties may be NULL or a property query string (e.g., "fips=yes").
Returned EVP_MD must be freed with EVP_MD_free when no longer needed.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check.

functions.name: EVP_MD_up_ref
functions.description: Increment the reference count of an EVP_MD object. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.
requirements: md must be a valid EVP_MD pointer.
Use EVP_MD_free to decrement reference count when done.
Check return value for success.

functions.name: EVP_MD_free
functions.description: Decrement the reference count of an EVP_MD and free it when it reaches zero.
requirements: md may be NULL (no-op).
Do not use md after it has been freed.

functions.name: EVP_read_pw_string
functions.signature: int EVP_read_pw_string(char *buf, int length, const char *prompt, int verify);
functions.description: Prompt for a password on the terminal and read it into buf. Optionally verifies by asking twice. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: buf must point to a writable buffer of size at least length bytes.
length must be > 0.
prompt may be NULL (library default prompt used) or a printable string.
If verify != 0, user is prompted twice and the inputs must match.
On success, buf is NUL-terminated. Caller must check return value.

functions.name: EVP_read_pw_string_min
functions.signature: int EVP_read_pw_string_min(char *buf, int minlen, int maxlen, const char *prompt, int verify);
functions.description: Prompt for a password with explicit minimum and maximum lengths, optionally verify. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: buf must point to a writable buffer of at least maxlen bytes.
minlen and maxlen define acceptable password length bounds; they must be sensible (minlen <= maxlen).
prompt may be NULL for default prompt.
If verify != 0, user is prompted twice and the inputs must match.
On success, buf is NUL-terminated. Caller must check return value.

functions.name: EVP_set_pw_prompt
functions.description: Set a process-global password prompt string used by EVP_read_pw_string* when prompt is NULL.
requirements: prompt may be NULL (behavior unspecified here; likely clears custom prompt—unknown).
Affects subsequent password reads globally; ensure thread-safety in multi-threaded applications (unknown guarantees).

functions.name: EVP_get_pw_prompt
functions.description: Get the process-global password prompt string set by EVP_set_pw_prompt. Returns a pointer to an internal string or NULL if unset.
requirements: Returned pointer must not be freed or modified by the caller.
May return NULL if no prompt configured.

functions.name: EVP_BytesToKey
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_BytesToKey(const EVP_CIPHER *type, const EVP_MD *md, const unsigned char *salt, const unsigned char *data, int datal, int count, unsigned char *key, unsigned char *iv);
functions.description: Derive a key and IV from password data using a legacy OpenSSL KDF (PKCS#5 v1.5-like). Returns the key length in bytes, or 0 on error.
requirements: type must be a valid cipher specifying required key and IV sizes.
md must be a valid digest (e.g., EVP_sha256) or NULL for default (legacy behavior).
salt may be NULL or 8-byte salt per PKCS5; using NULL reduces security.
data points to password bytes; datal is its length (may be -1 for NUL-terminated, per legacy conventions; not explicit here—unknown).
count iteration count must be >= 1.
key and iv must have sufficient space for the cipher’s key and IV lengths.
Return value must be checked; 0 indicates failure.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_flags
functions.description: Set additional flags on a cipher context (OR into existing flags). Used to alter cipher behavior per-ctx.
requirements: ctx must be a valid cipher context.
flags must be a combination of supported EVP_CIPHER_CTX flags (e.g., EVP_CIPHER_CTX_FLAG_WRAP_ALLOW).
Effect of unsupported flags is undefined (unknown).

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_clear_flags
functions.description: Clear specified flags from a cipher context.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
flags selects which bits to clear; only valid flag bits have effect.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_test_flags
functions.description: Test whether any of the provided flags are set in the cipher context. Returns non-zero if any match, 0 otherwise.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
flags is a mask of flags to test.

functions.name: EVP_EncryptInit
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_EncryptInit(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, const unsigned char *key, const unsigned char *iv);
functions.description: Initialize a cipher context for encryption with the specified cipher, key, and IV. Convenience wrapper for EVP_EncryptInit_ex with default engine.
requirements: ctx must be allocated and reset (via EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new/reset).
cipher must be a valid cipher or NULL to reuse previous cipher (legacy behavior; unknown here).
key and iv must match the cipher’s required lengths; may be NULL if the cipher allows lazy init (EVP_CIPH_ALWAYS_CALL_INIT).
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure; caller must check.

functions.name: EVP_EncryptInit_ex
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_EncryptInit_ex(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, ENGINE *impl /* must be NULL */, const unsigned char *key, const unsigned char *iv);
functions.description: Initialize a cipher context for encryption, specifying the cipher and key/IV. ENGINE parameter must be NULL in OpenSSL 3.x.
requirements: impl must be NULL.
Other requirements as per EVP_EncryptInit.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: EVP_EncryptInit_ex2
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_EncryptInit_ex2(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, const unsigned char *key, const unsigned char *iv, const OSSL_PARAM params[]);
functions.description: Initialize encryption and optionally set provider parameters via params (e.g., AEAD tag length, IV length).
requirements: ctx must be valid; cipher may be NULL to reuse.
params may be NULL or a list of OSSL_PARAM key/value pairs understood by the cipher (see EVP_CIPHER_settable_ctx_params).
key and iv sizes must be correct for the cipher or set via params if supported (e.g., IV length).
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: EVP_EncryptUpdate
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_EncryptUpdate(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *out, int *outl, const unsigned char *in, int inl);
functions.description: Encrypt data inl bytes from in, producing output to out. Can be called multiple times. Sets *outl to bytes written.
requirements: ctx must be initialized for encryption.
out must have sufficient space; for block ciphers allow inl + block_size - 1.
outl must be non-NULL to receive output length.
in may be NULL with inl=0 for certain control flows.
Returns 1 on success; caller must check and use *outl.

functions.name: EVP_EncryptFinal_ex
functions.description: Finalize encryption, writing any remaining buffered data and padding (if enabled). Sets *outl to bytes written.
requirements: ctx must be an active encryption context.
out must have at least block_size bytes for block ciphers with padding.
If no padding (EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding(ctx,0)), make sure data length is block aligned; otherwise function may fail.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: EVP_EncryptFinal
functions.description: Same as EVP_EncryptFinal_ex; non-_ex wrapper kept for compatibility.
requirements: Same as EVP_EncryptFinal_ex.

functions.name: EVP_DecryptInit
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DecryptInit(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, const unsigned char *key, const unsigned char *iv);
functions.description: Initialize a cipher context for decryption. Convenience wrapper for EVP_DecryptInit_ex with default engine.
requirements: ctx must be allocated/reset.
cipher/key/iv requirements match encryption counterpart.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: EVP_DecryptInit_ex
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DecryptInit_ex(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, ENGINE *impl /* must be NULL */, const unsigned char *key, const unsigned char *iv);
functions.description: Initialize decryption with explicit cipher and key/IV. ENGINE must be NULL in OpenSSL 3.x.
requirements: impl must be NULL.
Other requirements as per EVP_DecryptInit.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DecryptInit_ex2
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DecryptInit_ex2(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, const unsigned char *key, const unsigned char *iv, const OSSL_PARAM params[]);
functions.description: Initialize decryption and optionally set provider parameters for the cipher via params.
requirements: ctx valid; cipher may be NULL to reuse.
params may be NULL or valid parameter list for the cipher (see EVP_CIPHER_CTX_settable_params).
key/iv sizes must be correct or configured via params when supported.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: EVP_DecryptUpdate
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DecryptUpdate(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *out, int *outl, const unsigned char *in, int inl);
functions.description: Decrypt inl bytes from in, writing plaintext to out. Can be called multiple times. Sets *outl to bytes written.
requirements: ctx must be initialized for decryption.
out must have sufficient space; for block ciphers allow inl bytes (padding removed at final).
outl must be non-NULL.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DecryptFinal
functions.description: Finalize decryption, verify and strip padding if enabled, writing any remaining plaintext. Sets *outl. Returns 1 on success, 0 on padding/authentication failure.
requirements: ctx must be an active decryption context.
outm must have at least block_size bytes for block ciphers.
If padding disabled, total ciphertext length must be block aligned.
For AEAD ciphers, required tag must be set prior to final (e.g., via params/ctrl); otherwise final fails.

functions.name: EVP_DecryptFinal_ex
functions.description: Same as EVP_DecryptFinal; extended variant.
requirements: Same as EVP_DecryptFinal.

functions.name: EVP_CipherInit
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_CipherInit(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, const unsigned char *key, const unsigned char *iv, int enc);
functions.description: Initialize a cipher context for either encryption or decryption depending on enc (non-zero encrypt, zero decrypt). Convenience wrapper for EVP_CipherInit_ex with default engine.
requirements: ctx must be allocated/reset.
cipher must be valid or NULL to reuse previous (legacy).
key/iv lengths must match the cipher’s requirements.
enc selects operation (1 encrypt, 0 decrypt).
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_CipherInit_ex
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_CipherInit_ex(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, ENGINE *impl /* must be NULL */, const unsigned char *key, const unsigned char *iv, int enc);
functions.description: Initialize cipher context with explicit operation direction and engine (must be NULL).
requirements: impl must be NULL.
Other requirements as per EVP_CipherInit.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_CipherInit_SKEY
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_CipherInit_SKEY(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, EVP_SKEY *skey, const unsigned char *iv, size_t iv_len, int enc, const OSSL_PARAM params[]);
functions.description: Initialize a cipher context using an EVP_SKEY secret key object instead of raw key bytes, with optional params.
requirements: ctx must be valid; cipher specifies algorithm.
skey must be a valid secret key compatible with cipher.
iv may be NULL for stream or ciphers without IV; iv_len must correspond to provided iv.
enc selects encrypt (non-zero) or decrypt (0).
params may be NULL or supported parameters for the cipher.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_CipherInit_ex2
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_CipherInit_ex2(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, const unsigned char *key, const unsigned char *iv, int enc, const OSSL_PARAM params[]);
functions.description: Initialize cipher context for encryption or decryption and set provider params in one call.
requirements: ctx valid; cipher may be NULL to reuse.
key/iv sizes must match cipher or be configured via params if supported.
enc selects encrypt (non-zero) or decrypt (0).
params may be NULL or valid settable context params.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_CipherUpdate
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_CipherUpdate(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *out, int *outl, const unsigned char *in, int inl);
functions.description: Process input for either encryption or decryption depending on ctx mode. Writes output and sets *outl.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with encrypt/decrypt mode.
out must have sufficient space.
outl must be non-NULL.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_CipherFinal
functions.description: Finalize the cipher operation (encrypt or decrypt) according to ctx mode, handling any padding. Sets *outl. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.
requirements: ctx must be active.
outm must have at least block_size bytes for block ciphers.
Padding/AEAD rules as with EncryptFinal/DecryptFinal apply.
Check return value.

functions.name: EVP_CipherPipelineEncryptInit
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_CipherPipelineEncryptInit(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, const unsigned char *key, size_t keylen, size_t numpipes, const unsigned char **iv, size_t ivlen);
functions.description: Initialize a cipher context for pipelined encryption with multiple parallel input/output pipes. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: cipher must support pipeline (EVP_CIPH_FLAG_PIPELINE).
key/keylen must match cipher requirements.
numpipes must be between 1 and EVP_MAX_PIPES.
iv must point to an array of numpipes IV pointers when required; ivlen is IV length per pipe and must be correct.
ctx must be unused or reset for a new operation.

functions.name: EVP_CipherPipelineDecryptInit
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_CipherPipelineDecryptInit(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *cipher, const unsigned char *key, size_t keylen, size_t numpipes, const unsigned char **iv, size_t ivlen);
functions.description: Initialize a cipher context for pipelined decryption with multiple pipes. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: Same structural requirements as EncryptInit pipeline regarding cipher support, key, iv, numpipes.
ctx must be prepared for decryption.

functions.name: EVP_CipherPipelineUpdate
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_CipherPipelineUpdate(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, unsigned char **out, size_t *outl, const size_t *outsize, const unsigned char **in, const size_t *inl);
functions.description: Process pipelined encryption/decryption across multiple pipes. Writes outputs to provided buffers and sets per-pipe output lengths.
requirements: ctx must be initialized for pipeline mode.
out must be an array of numpipes output buffers; each buffer must be at least outsize[i] bytes.
outl must be an array to receive numpipes lengths.
in must be an array of numpipes input buffers; inl must be array of lengths.
Returns 1 on success; caller must check.

functions.name: EVP_CipherPipelineFinal
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_CipherPipelineFinal(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, unsigned char **outm, size_t *outl, const size_t *outsize);
functions.description: Finalize a pipelined cipher operation for all pipes, emitting any remaining data/padding into outm[i] and setting outl[i].
requirements: ctx must be in a pipelined operation state.
outm/outl/outsize arrays must provide slots for all pipes with adequate space.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: EVP_CipherFinal_ex
functions.description: Extended variant of EVP_CipherFinal. Finalize encryption/decryption with padding as per ctx configuration.
requirements: Same as EVP_CipherFinal.

functions.name: EVP_SignFinal
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_SignFinal(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *s, EVP_PKEY *pkey);
functions.description: Legacy one-shot sign of a digest value accumulated in ctx using pkey. Writes signature to md and length to *s. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with a digest and updated with data.
pkey must be a private key capable of signing and compatible with the digest/algorithm.
md must have enough space for signature (EVP_PKEY_size).
Caller must check return value.

functions.name: EVP_SignFinal_ex
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_SignFinal_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *s, EVP_PKEY *pkey, OSSL_LIB_CTX *libctx, const char *propq);
functions.description: Like EVP_SignFinal but allows specifying a library context and property query for provider selection during signing.
requirements: libctx may be NULL for default. propq may be NULL or a property query string.
Other requirements as per EVP_SignFinal.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSign
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DigestSign(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *sigret, size_t *siglen, const unsigned char *tbs, size_t tbslen);
functions.description: One-shot combined digest and sign operation. If sigret is NULL, sets *siglen to required size. Otherwise signs tbs buffer and writes signature to sigret and its length to *siglen.
requirements: ctx must be configured for DigestSign (e.g., via EVP_DigestSignInit* and optional params).
If sigret is NULL, *siglen is set to required signature length; otherwise sigret must have at least *siglen bytes on input or sufficient buffer size (pattern typical in OpenSSL).
tbs points to data to be signed; tbslen is its length.
Returns 1 on success; caller must check.

functions.name: EVP_VerifyFinal
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_VerifyFinal(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const unsigned char *sigbuf, unsigned int siglen, EVP_PKEY *pkey);
functions.description: Legacy verify the signature sigbuf of the digest accumulated in ctx using public key pkey. Returns 1 on success (valid), 0 on failure/invalid, -1 on error (legacy semantics; exact codes unknown here).
requirements: ctx must contain the computed digest of the message to verify.
pkey must be a public key corresponding to the signer.
sigbuf/siglen must contain the signature bytes.
Caller must interpret return value appropriately.

functions.name: EVP_VerifyFinal_ex
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_VerifyFinal_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const unsigned char *sigbuf, unsigned int siglen, EVP_PKEY *pkey, OSSL_LIB_CTX *libctx, const char *propq);
functions.description: Like EVP_VerifyFinal but allows specifying a library context and property query for provider selection.
requirements: libctx may be NULL; propq may be NULL.
Other requirements as per EVP_VerifyFinal.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerify
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DigestVerify(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const unsigned char *sigret, size_t siglen, const unsigned char *tbs, size_t tbslen);
functions.description: One-shot combined digest and verify operation. Returns 1 if signature is valid, 0 if invalid, and negative on error (typical pattern; exact codes not specified here).
requirements: ctx must be configured for DigestVerify (via EVP_DigestVerifyInit*).
sigret/siglen contain the signature to verify.
tbs/tbslen contain the message.
Caller must check return value.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignInit_ex
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DigestSignInit_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, EVP_PKEY_CTX **pctx, const char *mdname, OSSL_LIB_CTX *libctx, const char *props, EVP_PKEY *pkey, const OSSL_PARAM params[]);
functions.description: Initialize a digest-sign operation on ctx using a named digest and private key pkey, with provider selection via libctx/props and optional params for the signature algorithm.
requirements: ctx must be a fresh or reset EVP_MD_CTX.
pkey must be a private key suitable for signing.
mdname may be NULL for algorithm defaults or a valid digest name string.
libctx may be NULL; props may be NULL or a property query string.
If pctx is non-NULL, receives the underlying EVP_PKEY_CTX; caller may further configure it.
params may be NULL or algorithm-specific parameters.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignInit
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DigestSignInit(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, EVP_PKEY_CTX **pctx, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *e /* must be NULL */, EVP_PKEY *pkey);
functions.description: Initialize a digest-sign operation with a specific EVP_MD and pkey. ENGINE must be NULL in OpenSSL 3.x.
requirements: e must be NULL.
type may be NULL for defaults or a valid digest.
pkey must be a signing private key.
If pctx non-NULL, receives EVP_PKEY_CTX.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignUpdate
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DigestSignUpdate(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const void *data, size_t dsize);
functions.description: Feed more data into an active digest-sign operation.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized for DigestSign.
data may be any buffer of length dsize (dsize may be 0).
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignFinal
functions.description: Finalize a digest-sign operation producing a signature. If sigret is NULL, sets *siglen to required size; otherwise writes signature to sigret and updates *siglen.
requirements: ctx must be in a DigestSign operation state.
If sigret is NULL, *siglen is set to required size. Otherwise sigret must have space for the signature.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyInit_ex
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DigestVerifyInit_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, EVP_PKEY_CTX **pctx, const char *mdname, OSSL_LIB_CTX *libctx, const char *props, EVP_PKEY *pkey, const OSSL_PARAM params[]);
functions.description: Initialize a digest-verify operation using named digest and public key pkey, with provider selection and algorithm params.
requirements: ctx must be a fresh/reset EVP_MD_CTX.
pkey must be a verification-capable key (public or paired).
mdname may be NULL or a valid digest name.
libctx/props may be NULL for defaults.
If pctx non-NULL, receives EVP_PKEY_CTX for further control.
params may be NULL or algorithm-specific.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyInit
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DigestVerifyInit(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, EVP_PKEY_CTX **pctx, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *e /* must be NULL */, EVP_PKEY *pkey);
functions.description: Initialize a digest-verify operation with a specific EVP_MD and key. ENGINE must be NULL.
requirements: e must be NULL.
type may be NULL or a valid digest.
pkey must be suitable for verification.
If pctx non-NULL, receives EVP_PKEY_CTX.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyUpdate
functions.signature: int EVP_DigestVerifyUpdate(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const void *data, size_t dsize);
functions.description: Feed more data into an active digest-verify operation.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized for DigestVerify.
data may be any buffer of length dsize.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyFinal
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_DigestVerifyFinal(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const unsigned char *sig, size_t siglen);
functions.description: Finalize a digest-verify operation by verifying sig against the computed digest. Returns 1 if valid, 0 if invalid, negative on error (typical).
requirements: ctx must be in a DigestVerify operation state.
sig/siglen provide the signature bytes to verify.
Caller must check return value.

functions.name: EVP_OpenInit
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_OpenInit(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *type, const unsigned char *ek, int ekl, const unsigned char *iv, EVP_PKEY *priv);
functions.description: Initialize a public-key envelope decryption (CMS/PKCS#7-style). Decrypts the session key ek using private key priv, initializes ctx with cipher type and iv for subsequent EVP_OpenUpdate/Final.
requirements: ctx must be allocated/reset.
type must be a symmetric cipher algorithm used to encrypt the content.
ek/ekl contain the encrypted session key for the recipient; length depends on the public-key scheme.
iv must be the IV used for content encryption (if applicable).
priv must be the recipient’s private key matching the encrypted key.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_OpenFinal
functions.description: Finalize envelope decryption writing any remaining plaintext and handling padding. Use after EVP_OpenInit and EVP_DecryptUpdate/EVP_OpenUpdate.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized via EVP_OpenInit and used for decryption updates.
out must have sufficient space (at least block size).
Sets *outl to bytes written. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_SealInit
functions.signature: __owur int EVP_SealInit(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, const EVP_CIPHER *type, unsigned char **ek, int *ekl, unsigned char *iv, EVP_PKEY **pubk, int npubk);
functions.description: Initialize public-key envelope encryption. Generates a random session key and IV for cipher type, encrypts it for each recipient in pubk, returning npubk encrypted keys in ek[] and their lengths in ekl[].
requirements: ctx must be allocated/reset.
type is the symmetric cipher used for content encryption.
ek must point to an array of at least npubk unsigned char* pointers; each will be allocated by the function (caller must free).
ekl must point to an array of at least npubk ints to receive lengths.
iv must be a buffer of the cipher IV length; it will be set to the generated IV.
pubk must point to an array of npubk recipient public keys; each must be suitable for key transport.
npubk must be >= 1.
Returns 1 on success; caller must free each ek[i].

functions.name: EVP_SealFinal
functions.description: Finalize envelope encryption, writing remaining ciphertext and padding if needed. Sets *outl. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized via EVP_SealInit and used for encryption updates.
out must have sufficient space.

functions.name: EVP_ENCODE_CTX_new
functions.description: Allocate and return a new base64 encode/decode context.
requirements: Returns NULL on allocation failure; caller must free with EVP_ENCODE_CTX_free.

functions.name: EVP_ENCODE_CTX_free
functions.description: Free an EVP_ENCODE_CTX allocated with EVP_ENCODE_CTX_new.
requirements: ctx may be NULL (no-op).

functions.name: EVP_ENCODE_CTX_copy
functions.description: Copy the state of sctx into dctx. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.
requirements: dctx and sctx must be valid contexts; dctx must be initialized (allocated).
Caller must check return value.

functions.name: EVP_ENCODE_CTX_num
functions.description: Return the number of bytes currently pending in the internal encode/decode buffer (base64).
requirements: ctx must be valid.

functions.name: EVP_EncodeInit
functions.description: Initialize or reset a base64 encoding context for a new encoding operation.
requirements: ctx must be valid.

functions.name: EVP_EncodeUpdate
functions.signature: int EVP_EncodeUpdate(EVP_ENCODE_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *out, int *outl, const unsigned char *in, int inl);
functions.description: Encode binary data in to base64, writing base64 text to out and setting *outl to bytes written. Can be called repeatedly.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_EncodeInit.
out must have enough space (base64 expands by 4/3 plus line breaks).
outl must be non-NULL.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_EncodeFinal
functions.description: Finalize base64 encoding, writing any remaining output and padding. Sets *outl to bytes written.
requirements: ctx must be in encoding state.
out must have enough space (up to ~4 bytes).
outl must be non-NULL.

functions.name: EVP_EncodeBlock
functions.signature: int EVP_EncodeBlock(unsigned char *t, const unsigned char *f, int n);
functions.description: Encode n bytes from f to base64 in a single block, writing to t. Returns length of base64 output.
requirements: t must have at least EVP_ENCODE_LENGTH(n) bytes available.
f may be any binary data.
n must be >= 0.

functions.name: EVP_DecodeInit
functions.description: Initialize or reset a base64 decoding context for a new decoding operation.
requirements: ctx must be valid.

functions.name: EVP_DecodeUpdate
functions.signature: int EVP_DecodeUpdate(EVP_ENCODE_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *out, int *outl, const unsigned char *in, int inl);
functions.description: Decode base64 input bytes into binary output. Updates out and sets *outl. Can be called repeatedly. Returns a status code (non-negative on success; exact semantics not documented here).
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_DecodeInit.
out must have enough space (base64 shrinks by ~3/4).
outl must be non-NULL.
in/inl contain base64 text which may include newlines.

functions.name: EVP_DecodeFinal
functions.description: Finalize base64 decoding, writing any remaining decoded bytes and setting *outl. Returns a status code (0 on success is common pattern; exact semantics unknown here).
requirements: ctx must be in decoding state.
out must have space for up to 3 bytes.
outl must be non-NULL.

functions.name: EVP_DecodeBlock
functions.signature: int EVP_DecodeBlock(unsigned char *t, const unsigned char *f, int n);
functions.description: Decode a block of base64 text f of length n into binary, writing to t. Returns number of bytes produced, or negative on error (typical).
requirements: t must have enough space (<= 3*(n/4) bytes).
f must contain only valid base64 characters and padding for correct behavior.
n must be >= 0.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new
functions.description: Allocate and return a new cipher context.
requirements: Returns NULL on allocation failure; free with EVP_CIPHER_CTX_free.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_reset
functions.description: Reset and cleanup a cipher context for reuse. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.
requirements: c may be NULL (behavior unknown; typical is return 1).
After reset, ctx can be reinitialized.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_free
functions.description: Free a cipher context allocated by EVP_CIPHER_CTX_new or otherwise initialized, releasing resources.
requirements: c may be NULL (no-op).
Do not use c after freeing.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_key_length
functions.description: Set a non-default key length for ciphers that support variable key lengths (e.g., RC2/RC4/AES-*, where applicable). Returns 1 on success.
requirements: x must be initialized with a cipher supporting variable key lengths (EVP_CIPH_VARIABLE_LENGTH).
keylen must be a supported length for the cipher; otherwise returns 0.
Call before setting the key or as allowed by the cipher.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_padding
functions.description: Enable or disable standard block padding (PKCS#7 by default). pad=1 enables, pad=0 disables. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: c must be initialized.
When padding disabled, total plaintext/ciphertext length must be multiple of block size for block ciphers.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl
functions.signature: int EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl(EVP_CIPHER_CTX *ctx, int type, int arg, void *ptr);
functions.description: Generic control function to get/set cipher-specific parameters (e.g., AEAD tag, IV lengths). Returns 1 on success for supported controls.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with a cipher supporting the requested control.
type must be one of EVP_CTRL_* values appropriate for the cipher/mode.
arg and ptr meaning depend on type (see header constants).
Returns 0 or negative on unsupported/failed control; caller must check.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_rand_key
functions.description: Generate a random key suitable for the cipher in ctx and write it to key. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with a cipher that supports random key generation (EVP_CIPH_RAND_KEY).
key buffer must be at least EVP_CIPHER_CTX_key_length(ctx) bytes.
Caller must check return value.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_get_params
functions.description: Query or set algorithm-global parameters of a fetched EVP_CIPHER via OSSL_PARAM array (provider-facing). Returns 1 on success.
requirements: cipher must be a fetched (provider) cipher object; legacy ciphers may not support this (unknown).
params must be an OSSL_PARAM array with keys supported by this cipher (see EVP_CIPHER_gettable_params).
Returns 1 on success; 0 on failure.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_params
functions.description: Set context-specific parameters on a cipher context via OSSL_PARAM list (e.g., AEAD tag length, IV length).
requirements: ctx must be initialized with a cipher supporting the parameters.
params must be a NULL-terminated OSSL_PARAM array with supported keys (see EVP_CIPHER_CTX_settable_params).
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_params
functions.description: Get context-specific parameters from a cipher context via OSSL_PARAM list.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
params must contain keys supported by the cipher (see EVP_CIPHER_CTX_gettable_params).
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_gettable_params
functions.description: Return a descriptor array of OSSL_PARAM items that can be queried/set at the cipher (algorithm) level.
requirements: cipher must be valid.
Returned pointer is owned by the provider; do not free or modify.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_settable_ctx_params
functions.description: Return a descriptor array of OSSL_PARAM items that can be set on the cipher context via EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_params.
requirements: cipher must be valid.
Do not free/modify the returned array.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_gettable_ctx_params
functions.description: Return a descriptor array of OSSL_PARAM items that can be read from the cipher context via EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_params.
requirements: cipher must be valid.
Do not free/modify the returned array.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_settable_params
functions.description: Return a descriptor array of settable OSSL_PARAM items for the specific cipher context instance.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with a cipher.
Do not free/modify the returned array.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_gettable_params
functions.description: Return a descriptor array of gettable OSSL_PARAM items for the specific cipher context instance.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
Do not free/modify the returned array.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_algor_params
functions.description: Apply parameters from an X509_ALGOR to a cipher context (for algorithms serialized in ASN.1). Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid; typically used when parsing ASN.1 structures like AlgorithmIdentifier.
alg must be a valid X509_ALGOR with parameters compatible with ctx’s cipher.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_algor_params
functions.description: Export parameters from a cipher context into an X509_ALGOR structure. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
alg must be a valid X509_ALGOR to receive parameters.
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_algor
functions.description: Get an X509_ALGOR representing the cipher algorithm and parameters for this context. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
alg must be a non-NULL pointer to receive an allocated or referenced X509_ALGOR (ownership/alloc semantics unknown here).
Returns 1 on success; caller must manage returned object per OpenSSL rules.

functions.name: BIO_f_md
functions.description: Get the BIO filter method for message-digest BIOs (digest-as-a-filter).
requirements: Returned BIO_METHOD is static; do not free.
Used with BIO_new/BIO_push to build filter chains.

functions.name: BIO_f_base64
functions.description: Get the BIO filter method for base64 encoding/decoding.
requirements: Returned method is static; do not free.

functions.name: BIO_f_cipher
functions.description: Get the BIO filter method for symmetric cipher operations.
requirements: Returned method is static; do not free.

functions.name: BIO_f_reliable
functions.description: Get the BIO filter method providing a reliable transport (e.g., with integrity). Specifics depend on OpenSSL build; details not documented here.
requirements: Returned method is static; do not free.
Use depends on availability and configuration.

functions.name: BIO_set_cipher
functions.signature: __owur int BIO_set_cipher(BIO *b, const EVP_CIPHER *c, const unsigned char *k, const unsigned char *i, int enc);
functions.description: Configure a cipher BIO with a cipher algorithm, key, IV and direction (enc=1 encrypt, 0 decrypt). Returns 1 on success.
requirements: b must be a cipher BIO created with BIO_f_cipher.
c must be a valid cipher method.
k must point to a key of proper length; i must point to an IV of proper length if required by c.
enc selects encryption (1) or decryption (0).
Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: EVP_md_null
functions.description: Return a no-op message-digest method that produces no output. Useful as a placeholder.
requirements: Returned pointer is static; do not free.
Not suitable for security-sensitive hashing.

functions.name: X509_CRL_set_default_method
functions.description: Sets the library-wide default CRL method (callbacks for CRL operations). Use when providing a custom X509_CRL_METHOD to override default behavior.
requirements: meth must point to a valid, initialized X509_CRL_METHOD structure.
No ownership is transferred; meth must remain valid for as long as used as default.
Threading/global-effects considerations are unknown; callers should assume setting a global default may affect other CRL operations in the same process.

functions.name: X509_CRL_METHOD_new
functions.signature: X509_CRL_METHOD *X509_CRL_METHOD_new(int (*crl_init)(X509_CRL *crl), int (*crl_free)(X509_CRL *crl), int (*crl_lookup)(X509_CRL *crl, X509_REVOKED **ret, const ASN1_INTEGER *serial, const X509_NAME *issuer), int (*crl_verify)(X509_CRL *crl, EVP_PKEY *pk));
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new X509_CRL_METHOD with user-supplied callback functions for CRL initialization, freeing, lookup, and verification.
requirements: Callback function pointers may be NULL if not implemented (behavior unspecified/unknown).
Returned X509_CRL_METHOD must be freed with X509_CRL_METHOD_free.
Each callback, if provided, must obey the expected signatures and semantics (exact semantics not documented here; infer from names).

functions.name: X509_CRL_METHOD_free
functions.description: Frees an X509_CRL_METHOD previously allocated by X509_CRL_METHOD_new.
requirements: m may be NULL (behavior not specified; typical OpenSSL free functions accept NULL).
After calling, m must not be used.

functions.name: X509_CRL_set_meth_data
functions.description: Associates opaque method-specific data with a CRL object for use by custom X509_CRL_METHOD callbacks.
requirements: crl must be a valid, initialized X509_CRL pointer.
dat is stored as-is; ownership and lifetime management are caller-defined/unknown.

functions.name: X509_CRL_get_meth_data
functions.description: Retrieves the opaque method-specific data previously set on a CRL via X509_CRL_set_meth_data.
requirements: crl must be a valid, initialized X509_CRL pointer.
Returned pointer validity and ownership follow what the caller set; may be NULL if none set.

functions.name: X509_verify_cert_error_string
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string for a certificate verification error code.
requirements: n should be a verification error code returned by OpenSSL verification routines.
Returned string is a static, null-terminated C string; do not free.

functions.name: X509_verify
functions.description: Verifies the signature on certificate a using the public key r.
requirements: a must be a valid X509 with a populated signature and tbs section.
r must be a valid EVP_PKEY holding the appropriate public key for the certificate’s signature algorithm.
Returns success/failure per OpenSSL convention; exact return semantics unknown from header.

functions.name: X509_self_signed
functions.description: Checks if cert is self-signed. If verify_signature is nonzero, also verifies the signature using the certificate’s own public key.
requirements: cert must be a valid X509 pointer.
verify_signature typically 0/1; exact accepted range unknown.
Return value semantics are not specified in header; treat as success/failure indicator.

functions.name: X509_REQ_verify_ex
functions.signature: int X509_REQ_verify_ex(X509_REQ *a, EVP_PKEY *r, OSSL_LIB_CTX *libctx, const char *propq);
functions.description: Verifies a certificate signing request (CSR) signature using the provided public key, with optional library context and property query for algorithms/providers.
requirements: a must be a valid X509_REQ.
r must be a valid EVP_PKEY matching the CSR’s key type.
libctx and propq may be NULL to use defaults.
Return value follows OpenSSL success/failure conventions; exact values unknown.

functions.name: X509_REQ_verify
functions.description: Verifies the signature on CSR a using public key r.
requirements: a must be a valid X509_REQ.
r must be a valid EVP_PKEY matching the CSR key type.
Return semantics per OpenSSL convention; exact values unknown.

functions.name: X509_CRL_verify
functions.description: Verifies the signature on a CRL using the provided public key.
requirements: a must be a valid X509_CRL with a signature.
r must be a valid EVP_PKEY matching the CRL signature algorithm.
Return semantics follow OpenSSL conventions; exact values unknown.

functions.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_verify
functions.description: Verifies the signature on a legacy Netscape SPKI structure using the provided public key.
requirements: a must be a valid NETSCAPE_SPKI pointer.
r must be a valid EVP_PKEY for the signature algorithm used in a.
Return semantics unknown; treat as success/failure.

functions.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_b64_decode
functions.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded SPKI string into a NETSCAPE_SPKI object.
requirements: str must point to Base64 text containing an SPKI; may be NUL-terminated.
len specifies input length; if negative/unknown behavior not specified here.
Returned object must be freed with appropriate free function (not shown here).

functions.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_b64_encode
functions.description: Encodes a NETSCAPE_SPKI into a newly allocated Base64 string.
requirements: x must be a valid NETSCAPE_SPKI.
Returned char* is heap-allocated; caller must free with OPENSSL_free or equivalent (exact free routine not stated; typical OpenSSL string free).

functions.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_get_pubkey
functions.description: Extracts the public key from a NETSCAPE_SPKI as an EVP_PKEY.
requirements: x must be a valid NETSCAPE_SPKI.
Returned EVP_PKEY must be freed by caller with EVP_PKEY_free.

functions.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_set_pubkey
functions.description: Sets the public key of a NETSCAPE_SPKI from an EVP_PKEY.
requirements: x must be a valid NETSCAPE_SPKI.
pkey must be a valid EVP_PKEY; no ownership transfer implied (unknown specifics).
Return indicates success/failure; exact semantics unknown.

functions.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_print
functions.description: Prints a human-readable representation of a NETSCAPE_SPKI to a BIO.
requirements: out must be a valid BIO opened for writing.
spki must be a valid NETSCAPE_SPKI.
Return indicates success/failure; exact values unknown.

functions.name: X509_signature_dump
functions.signature: int X509_signature_dump(BIO *bp, const ASN1_STRING *sig, int indent);
functions.description: Dumps a signature (ASN1_STRING) in a hex-like form to the BIO with indent.
requirements: bp must be a valid BIO opened for writing.
sig must be a valid ASN1_STRING containing signature bytes.
indent is a non-negative indentation (range constraints unknown).

functions.name: X509_signature_print
functions.signature: int X509_signature_print(BIO *bp, const X509_ALGOR *alg, const ASN1_STRING *sig);
functions.description: Prints the signature algorithm and signature bytes to the BIO in a readable form.
requirements: bp must be a valid writable BIO.
alg must be a valid X509_ALGOR describing the signature algorithm.
sig must be a valid ASN1_STRING containing the signature.

functions.name: X509_sign
functions.description: Signs certificate x using the private key pkey and message digest md, updating its signature fields.
requirements: x must be a valid X509 with populated TBS fields.
pkey must be a valid EVP_PKEY containing the private key for the desired signature algorithm.
md should be a valid digest suitable for pkey; if NULL behavior is provider/algorithm dependent (unknown).
On success, x is modified in-place.

functions.name: X509_sign_ctx
functions.description: Signs certificate x using a pre-initialized EVP_MD_CTX (which must be configured for signing).
requirements: x must be a valid X509.
ctx must be an initialized EVP_MD_CTX set up for signing with appropriate PKEY and digest.
On success, x is modified in-place.

functions.name: X509_REQ_sign
functions.description: Signs a certificate signing request using pkey and md, updating the CSR signature.
requirements: x must be a valid X509_REQ with appropriate fields set.
pkey must be a valid private key EVP_PKEY.
md should be compatible with pkey; NULL handling unknown.
Modifies x on success.

functions.name: X509_REQ_sign_ctx
functions.description: Signs a CSR using a pre-configured EVP_MD_CTX.
requirements: x must be a valid X509_REQ.
ctx must be initialized for signing with a private key and digest.
Modifies x on success.

functions.name: X509_CRL_sign
functions.description: Signs a CRL using the private key pkey and digest md, updating the CRL signature.
requirements: x must be a valid X509_CRL with TBS fields set.
pkey must be a valid private key EVP_PKEY.
md must be suitable for pkey; NULL handling unknown.
Modifies x on success.

functions.name: X509_CRL_sign_ctx
functions.description: Signs a CRL using a pre-initialized EVP_MD_CTX configured for signing.
requirements: x must be a valid X509_CRL.
ctx must be initialized with appropriate private key and digest for signing.
Modifies x on success.

functions.name: NETSCAPE_SPKI_sign
functions.description: Signs a legacy NETSCAPE_SPKI structure using pkey and md.
requirements: x must be a valid NETSCAPE_SPKI.
pkey must be a valid private key EVP_PKEY.
md should be compatible with pkey; NULL handling unknown.
Modifies x on success.

functions.name: X509_pubkey_digest
functions.signature: int X509_pubkey_digest(const X509 *data, const EVP_MD *type, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *len);
functions.description: Computes a digest of the certificate’s public key using the specified message digest and writes it to md.
requirements: data must be a valid X509.
type must be a valid digest algorithm (NULL handling unknown).
md must point to a buffer large enough for the digest output (exact size depends on type; not specified here).
len must be a valid pointer to receive the output length.

functions.name: X509_digest
functions.signature: int X509_digest(const X509 *data, const EVP_MD *type, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *len);
functions.description: Computes a digest of the DER encoding of the certificate using the specified message digest.
requirements: data must be a valid X509.
type must be a valid digest algorithm.
md must have sufficient space for the digest.
len must be a valid pointer for output length.

functions.name: X509_digest_sig
functions.description: Obtains the digest of the certificate signature (signatureValue) and indicates which digest algorithm was used and whether it was a fallback.
requirements: cert must be a valid X509.
md_used may be NULL or a pointer to receive the digest algorithm used (ownership of returned EVP_MD* is unknown).
md_is_fallback may be NULL or a pointer to receive a flag indicating fallback usage (exact semantics unknown).
Returns an ASN1_OCTET_STRING pointer that the caller must eventually free (exact free routine not specified here).

functions.name: X509_CRL_digest
functions.signature: int X509_CRL_digest(const X509_CRL *data, const EVP_MD *type, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *len);
functions.description: Computes a digest of the DER encoding of a CRL using the specified message digest.
requirements: data must be a valid X509_CRL.
type must be a valid digest algorithm.
md must be a buffer with sufficient size for the digest.
len must be a valid pointer to receive output length.

functions.name: X509_REQ_digest
functions.signature: int X509_REQ_digest(const X509_REQ *data, const EVP_MD *type, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *len);
functions.description: Computes a digest of the DER encoding of a CSR using the specified message digest.
requirements: data must be a valid X509_REQ.
type must be a valid digest algorithm.
md must be large enough for the digest output.
len must be a valid pointer to receive output length.

functions.name: X509_NAME_digest
functions.signature: int X509_NAME_digest(const X509_NAME *data, const EVP_MD *type, unsigned char *md, unsigned int *len);
functions.description: Computes a digest of the DER encoding of an X509_NAME using the specified message digest.
requirements: data must be a valid X509_NAME.
type must be a valid digest algorithm.
md must have sufficient storage for the digest.
len must be a valid pointer to receive output length.

functions.name: X509_load_http
functions.signature: X509 *X509_load_http(const char *url, BIO *bio, BIO *rbio, int timeout);
functions.description: Loads an X509 certificate from an HTTP URL using the given BIOs and timeout.
requirements: url must be a valid null-terminated URL string (HTTP).
bio and rbio are BIOs used for I/O; may be NULL to use internal defaults (exact behavior unknown).
timeout is in seconds; range/behavior unknown if negative.
Returned X509 must be freed with X509_free.

functions.name: X509_CRL_load_http
functions.signature: X509_CRL *X509_CRL_load_http(const char *url, BIO *bio, BIO *rbio, int timeout);
functions.description: Loads an X509 CRL from an HTTP URL using the given BIOs and timeout.
requirements: url must be a valid null-terminated URL string (HTTP).
bio and rbio are I/O BIOs; may be NULL to use defaults (behavior unknown).

functions.description: Applies decryption to a PEM data block using parameters in cipher. If the data is encrypted, obtains a passphrase via callback/u as needed and updates data/len in place.

data must point to a writable buffer containing the base64-decoded PEM body; decrypted data will be written back in place.
len must be non-NULL and on success updated to the plaintext length.
If the PEM is encrypted and no key string is provided in cipher, callback may be invoked to obtain a passphrase.

functions.name: PEM_bytes_read_bio_secmem

functions.description: Reads a PEM object with the given type name from a BIO into secure-memory buffers (if supported), optionally using a password callback for decryption.
requirements: pdata, plen, and pnm must be non-NULL to receive outputs.
name specifies the expected PEM label (e.g., "CERTIFICATE"); must not be NULL.
bp must be a valid readable BIO.
cb/u may be used to obtain a passphrase if the PEM is encrypted.

functions.name: PEM_write_bio
functions.signature: int PEM_write_bio(BIO *bp, const char *name, const char *hdr, const unsigned char *data, long len);
functions.description: Writes a PEM object to a BIO with the specified label, header line, and data block (data is base64-encoded with PEM armor).
requirements: bp must be a valid writable BIO.
name must be a non-NULL PEM label string (e.g., "CERTIFICATE").
hdr may be NULL or a header line; if encryption is desired, proper headers must be provided by the caller.
data must point to a buffer of length len.

functions.name: PEM_bytes_read_bio
functions.signature: int PEM_bytes_read_bio(unsigned char **pdata, long *plen, char **pnm, const char *name, BIO *bp, pem_password_cb *cb, void *u);
functions.description: Reads a PEM object with a specific label from a BIO, returning the decoded data and the actual label read. Supports encrypted PEM via callback.
requirements: pdata, plen, and pnm must be non-NULL outputs.
name specifies the expected PEM label; must not be NULL.
bp must be a valid readable BIO.
cb/u may be provided for passphrase acquisition if the PEM is encrypted.

functions.name: PEM_ASN1_read_bio
functions.signature: void *PEM_ASN1_read_bio(d2i_of_void *d2i, const char *name, BIO *bp, void **x, pem_password_cb *cb, void *u);
functions.description: Generic helper to read a PEM object from a BIO and decode it using a supplied ASN.1 d2i function to produce a specific object type.
requirements: d2i must be a valid ASN.1 decoder function pointer for the target type.
name must match the PEM label for the object being read.
bp must be a valid readable BIO.
x may be NULL or point to an existing object pointer compatible with the decoder.
cb/u may be needed if the PEM is encrypted.

functions.name: PEM_ASN1_write_bio
functions.signature: int PEM_ASN1_write_bio(i2d_of_void *i2d, const char *name, BIO *bp, const void *x, const EVP_CIPHER *enc, const unsigned char *kstr, int klen, pem_password_cb *cb, void *u);
functions.description: Generic helper to encode an ASN.1 object using i2d and write it in PEM format to a BIO, optionally encrypting with the given cipher or password callback.
requirements: i2d must be a valid ASN.1 encoder for the object type of x.
name must be a valid PEM label string.
bp must be a valid writable BIO.
x must point to a valid object compatible with i2d.
If enc is non-NULL, either kstr/klen provide the encryption key derivation input or cb/u may be used to obtain a passphrase.

functions.name: PEM_ASN1_write_bio_ctx
functions.signature: int PEM_ASN1_write_bio_ctx(OSSL_i2d_of_void_ctx *i2d, void *vctx, const char *name, BIO *bp, const void *x, const EVP_CIPHER *enc, const unsigned char *kstr, int klen, pem_password_cb *cb, void *u);
functions.description: Context-aware variant of PEM_ASN1_write_bio that passes an extra context pointer to the i2d encoder when writing a PEM object, with optional encryption.
requirements: i2d must be a valid context-aware ASN.1 encoder function pointer.
vctx is an opaque context passed to i2d; must match the encoder's expectations.
name must be a valid PEM label.
bp must be a valid writable BIO.
x must point to a valid encodable object.
Encryption handling is the same as PEM_ASN1_write_bio.

functions.name: PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio
functions.description: Reads one or more PEM objects (certs, CRLs, keys) from a BIO into a STACK_OF(X509_INFO).
requirements: bp must be a valid readable BIO.
sk may be NULL or an existing STACK_OF(X509_INFO) to append to.
cb/u may be required for decrypting encrypted entries.

functions.name: PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio_ex

functions.description: Extended version of PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio allowing an OpenSSL library context and property query string for algorithm fetches.
requirements: bp must be a valid readable BIO.

functions.name: PEM_X509_INFO_write_bio

functions.description: Writes an X509_INFO structure to a BIO in PEM format, optionally encrypting private key contents.
requirements: bp must be a valid writable BIO.

If enc is non-NULL, either kstr/klen supply password data or cd/u may be used for passphrase input.

functions.name: PEM_read

functions.name: PEM_ASN1_write

functions.description: Generic helper to ASN.1-encode an object via i2d and write it in PEM format to a FILE*, optionally encrypting.

functions.name: PEM_SignInit
functions.description: Initializes an EVP_MD_CTX for a classic PEM-signing sequence with the given digest algorithm.
requirements: ctx must be a valid, initialized EVP_MD_CTX pointer.
type must be a valid message digest algorithm object.

functions.name: PEM_SignUpdate
functions.signature: int PEM_SignUpdate(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const unsigned char *d, unsigned int cnt);
functions.description: Feeds data into the message digest context as part of the PEM signing sequence.
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX initialized via PEM_SignInit or equivalent.
d must point to at least cnt bytes of data.

functions.name: PEM_SignFinal
functions.signature: int PEM_SignFinal(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, unsigned char *sigret, unsigned int *siglen, EVP_PKEY *pkey);
functions.description: Finalizes the signature over the data in ctx using the provided private key, writing the signature to sigret and its length to siglen.
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX with data added via PEM_SignUpdate.
sigret must point to a buffer large enough for the signature.
siglen must be non-NULL to receive the signature length.
pkey must hold a suitable private key for the initialized digest algorithm.

functions.name: PEM_def_callback
functions.signature: int PEM_def_callback(char *buf, int num, int rwflag, void *userdata);
functions.description: Default password callback used internally by PEM routines. Prompts or otherwise fills buf with a passphrase.
requirements: buf must point to a writable buffer of at least num bytes.
num is the maximum number of bytes to write to buf including the terminating NUL.
rwflag indicates read (0) or write (1) operation semantics.

functions.name: PEM_proc_type
functions.description: Formats and writes a Proc-Type header into buf indicating the PEM processing type (e.g., ENCRYPTED).
requirements: buf must be a writable buffer large enough to hold the generated header line.
type should be one of the PEM_TYPE_* constants.

functions.name: PEM_dek_info
functions.signature: void PEM_dek_info(char *buf, const char *type, int len, const char *str);
functions.description: Formats and writes a DEK-Info header line into buf describing the encryption algorithm and parameters used for a PEM object.
requirements: buf must be a writable buffer large enough for the header line.
type is the cipher name string; must not be NULL if a header is to be written.
len is the length of str in bytes; should match the parameter string length.
str points to the cipher parameter string (e.g., IV in hex).
